items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Albert Morgan played with him for a while, but not very long when I was in the band.

ctx.x: And he was, at one time he had Bob French playing, Bob French played tuba with him for a while. And Albert Morgan played with him, Albert Morgan played with him for a while, but not very long when I was in the band. And another bass player he had was Bob Lyons played with him for a while, while I was in the band. See, so I stayed in that band a good while. You see? And one time his clarinet player was, uh, Louie, Big Olly Louie. Yeah, Louie stayed in the band about one year. Louie was, Big Olly Louie was in the…
Well, what was that? No, I heard about something.
